subject: Wrong amount on invoice
body: The invoice for my March order shows a delivery fee that was not on the checkout page. Can you correct it and send me a new copy?

subject: Card taken three times
body: My card was charged three times for one pair of headphones and my rent payment bounced because of it. I need the money back today.

subject: Refund has not arrived
body: You confirmed my refund two weeks ago but nothing has reached my bank account. Can you check where it is?

subject: Change payment method
body: I would like to pay for my membership with a different card from next month. Where do I update it?

subject: Payment I did not make
body: There is a purchase of 900 dollars on my saved card that nobody in my family made. Please block the account before more is spent.

subject: Gift card balance
body: How can I see how much is left on my gift card, and can I use two of them on the same order?

subject: Subscription still billed
body: I cancelled in January and I am still being billed every month. This is the fourth time I am writing and I will dispute the charges with my bank.

subject: VAT receipt
body: Could you send a receipt with our company tax number for order 20418? It is for our yearly accounts, no hurry.

subject: Return unopened speaker
body: I bought a speaker as a gift and it is still sealed. What is the process for sending it back?

subject: Wrong item in the box
body: I ordered a blue jacket in medium and received a green one in small. How do I swap it for the right one?

subject: Return label does not work
body: The courier refused my parcel because the return label has expired. The return window closes tomorrow and I do not want to lose my money.

subject: Exchange for another size
body: These shoes are too tight. Could I exchange them for half a size larger?

subject: Dangerous battery, want to send back
body: The power bank I received started smoking while charging and burned the table. I want to return it and I need to know whether it is safe to post.

subject: How long for a return
body: I sent my tablet back on Monday. When should I expect you to confirm that you have it?

subject: Missing part in return
body: I returned a camera last week and only now noticed that my own memory card is still inside. Can it be sent to me?

subject: Trade for a newer model
body: I bought the watch ten days ago and you have just released a new one. May I return mine and pay the difference?

subject: Rude reply from your team
body: The person I spoke to on the phone hung up on me when I asked for a manager. I would like to make a complaint.

subject: Third time I ask
body: I have written three times about the same order and each answer is a copied text that does not help. Please give this to somebody who can decide.

subject: Change delivery address
body: I moved house yesterday. Could you send my order to the new address instead of the old one?

subject: Thank you to your agent
body: I just want to say that Priya in your chat was patient and solved everything. Please pass on my thanks.

subject: Order not delivered
body: My parcel was due on Friday and the tracking has not moved since Wednesday. Where is it?

subject: Medicine cooler lost in delivery
body: The cooler I ordered for my father's insulin was marked delivered but it is not here and he needs it tonight. Please find it.

subject: Update my name
body: I got married and would like the name on my account to be changed. Which document do you need?

subject: Cancel an order
body: I ordered two by mistake. Please cancel one of them if it has not left the warehouse.

subject: Opening hours
body: Are your stores open on public holidays, and until what time?

subject: Do you have a shop in Leeds
body: I would like to see the sofa before buying. Is there a branch near Leeds?

subject: Recycling
body: Do you collect old appliances for recycling when you deliver a new one?

subject: Company history
body: I am a student writing about family businesses. When was your company founded and by whom?

subject: Newsletter
body: Please tell me how to stop receiving the weekly newsletter.

subject: Press question before print
body: I am a reporter and our story about your recall goes to print in one hour. I need a statement from your press office now.

subject: Parking at the store
body: Is there free parking next to the main store and how long can I stay?

subject: Where are the products made
body: Could you tell me which countries your furniture comes from?

subject: Bulk order for a school
body: We need 120 tablets for a school in September. Do you offer a discount for that quantity and can we get a quote?

subject: Difference between two models
body: I cannot decide between the Pro and the Air. Which one is better for editing video?

subject: Will it be in stock
body: The grey armchair is sold out. Do you know when it will be available again?

subject: Student price
body: Do you have a lower price for students, and what proof is required?

subject: Quote needed before noon
body: Our board decides at noon today between you and a competitor. Without your quote for 400 laptops by then we will sign with them.

subject: Demo for our team
body: Could someone show us how the business plan works before we decide to buy?

subject: Price match
body: Another shop sells the same television for 50 dollars less. Would you match that price?

subject: Pre-order question
body: If I pre-order the phone now, will I be charged today or when it ships?

subject: Screen flickers
body: The television I bought in June flickers when the picture is dark. I have tried another cable. What else can I try?

subject: How to pair the earbuds
body: I cannot find how to connect the earbuds to a second phone. Could you explain the steps?

subject: Coffee machine leaks on the socket
body: Water is running out of the new coffee machine onto the power socket and there are sparks. What should I do?

subject: Battery lasts two hours
body: My laptop is three months old and the battery only lasts two hours. Is that covered by the warranty?

subject: Instruction manual
body: The manual was missing from the box of the bread maker. Can you email me one?

subject: Vacuum makes a loud noise
body: Since last week the vacuum cleaner makes a grinding noise on carpet. Does it need a new brush?

subject: Baby monitor stops at night
body: The baby monitor loses its picture every night and last night we did not hear our sick baby. We need a working one immediately.

subject: Cleaning the non-stick pan
body: What can I use to clean the pan without damaging the coating?

subject: App closes when I pay
body: Every time I press pay, the app closes. I have reinstalled it twice and my phone is up to date.

subject: Cannot reset password
body: The password reset email never arrives, also not in spam. How else can I get into my account?

subject: Somebody is in my account
body: I received alerts that my password and email were changed and I did not do it. My saved cards are in there. Please lock it.

subject: Website shows blank page
body: The order page stays white in my browser. It works on my neighbor's computer.

subject: Integration returns errors
body: Our warehouse system has received error 500 from your orders interface since this morning and we cannot ship anything to 2,000 customers.

subject: Two-factor code rejected
body: The app says my sign-in code is wrong although I type it at once. Is the clock on my phone the problem?

subject: Photos do not upload
body: I want to add photos to my review but the upload bar stops at 90 percent.

subject: Export is missing columns
body: The file I download from my purchase history no longer has the date column. Can it be added back?

subject: New laptop for a new colleague
body: A new colleague starts on the first of next month and will need a laptop and a mailbox.

subject: VPN drops at home
body: My work VPN disconnects every half hour since I changed my router. Can you help me set it up?

subject: Printer on floor two
body: The printer on the second floor prints empty pages. Please send someone when you have time.

subject: Ransom note on our file server
body: All files on the shared server have been renamed and a message asks for money. Please act now, it is spreading.

subject: Access to shared folder
body: May I have read access to the marketing folder? My manager agrees.

subject: Software installation
body: I would like the diagram program installed on my work computer. There is no rush.

subject: Nobody in the office can sign in
body: Since eight this morning none of our forty people can sign in to their work computers. Everything has stopped.
accepted_queues: IT Support;Service Outages and Maintenance;Technical Support

subject: Mailbox full
body: My mailbox says that it is nearly full. Can the limit be raised?

subject: Is the website down
body: Your website has not opened for an hour for me or my friends. Is there a problem on your side?

subject: Checkout down during our sale
body: The whole checkout has been unavailable for two hours in the middle of our sale and we are losing thousands every minute.

subject: Planned maintenance
body: Will the order tracking be available during the maintenance on Sunday night?

subject: Payment terminals offline in all stores
body: All card terminals in our twelve stores went offline at the same time and customers are leaving. We need this fixed at once.
accepted_queues: Service Outages and Maintenance;Technical Support;Billing and Payments

subject: When will it be back
body: The status page has said that the service is degraded since Tuesday. Is there a new estimate?

subject: Outage report
body: Could you send the report about last month's outage for our records?

subject: Alarm service not responding
body: The home alarm service is not answering at all and our burglary alarms are unprotected tonight. Please restore it now.

subject: Maintenance notice too late
body: I received the maintenance notice after the work had started. Could it be sent two days earlier next time?

subject: Job application status
body: I applied for the store manager position three weeks ago. Can you tell me whether it is still open?

subject: Holiday allowance
body: How many days of paid leave do I have left this year and how do I request them?

subject: Harassed by my supervisor
body: My supervisor threatened me again yesterday and I am afraid to come to work tomorrow. I need to speak to someone today.

subject: Payslip question
body: My payslip for May shows fewer hours than I worked. Whom can I ask about it?

subject: Reference letter
body: I left the company in April and need a letter confirming my employment.

subject: Parental leave
body: I would like to know how to apply for parental leave from November.

subject: Internship for my studies
body: Do you take interns in the design team during the winter term?

subject: Salary not paid
body: My salary has not been paid for two months and I cannot pay my rent this week. Please settle this now.
